{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_ids
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique patient_ids: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Duplicate patient_ids: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check how many times each patient_id appears
dup_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
dup_rows = dup_counts[dup_counts > 1]
print(f"Number of patients with multiple rows: {len(dup_rows)}")
print(f"Sample of patients with multiple rows: {dup_rows.head().to_dict()}")"}
